arpTimeout.description: Timeout value for dynamically learned ARP entries, <0..2678400> seconds

intrfMtu.description: Interface MTU GigabitEthernet0 <1500..1518>, Other GigabitEthernet <1500..9216> in bytes

ipMtu.description: IP MTU for GigabitEthernet main <576..Interface MTU>, GigabitEthernet subinterface <576..9216>, Other Interfaces <576..2000> in bytes

tcpMss.description: TCP MSS on SYN packets, in bytes

tlocExtension.description: Extends a local TLOC to a remote node only for vpn 0

tlocExtensionGreFrom.description: Extend remote TLOC over a GRE tunnel to a local WAN interface

xconnect.description: Extend remote TLOC over a GRE tunnel to a local WAN interface

all.description: Allow all traffic. Overrides all other allow-service options if allow-service all is set

bandwidthDownstream.description: Interface downstream bandwidth capacity, in kbps

bandwidthUpstream.description: Interface upstream bandwidth capacity, in kbps

blockNonSourceIp.description: Block packets originating from IP address that is not from this source

dhcpHelper.description: List of DHCP IPv4 helper addresses (min 1, max 8)

iperfServer.description: Iperf server for auto bandwidth detect

nat.description: enable Network Address Translation on this interface

sourceIp.description: Source IP address to be translated
Source IP address to be translated

tcpTimeout.description: Set NAT TCP session timeout, in minutes

udpTimeout.description: Set NAT UDP session timeout, in minutes

natIpv6.description: enable Network Address Translation ipv6 on this interface

enableEnforcedPropogation.description: Enable/Disable SGT Enforcement on an interface

enableSGTPropogation.description: Indicates that the interface is trustworthy for CTS

propagate.description: Enables the interface for CTS SGT authorization and forwarding

trusted.description: Indicates that the interface is trustworthy for CTS.

allowFragmentation.description: Allow Fragmentation and will clear DF bit in outer IP

bind.description: Bind loopback tunnel interface to a physical interface

clearDontFragment.description: Enable clear dont fragment (Currently Only SDWAN Tunnel Interface)

excludeControllerGroupList.description: Exclude the following controller groups defined in this list.

fullPortHop.description: Enable port hopping on the tunnel interface

helloInterval.description: Set time period of control hello packets <100..600000> milli seconds

helloTolerance.description: Set tolerance of control hello packets <12..6000> seconds

lowBandwidthLink.description: Set the interface as a low-bandwidth circuit

natRefreshInterval.description: Set time period of nat refresh packets <1...60> seconds

networkBroadcast.description: Accept and respond to network-prefix-directed broadcasts

portHop.description: The port hop functionality is deprecated for devices 17.18 and higher. Use the full-port-hop field instead

tunnelTcpMss.description: Tunnel TCP MSS on SYN packets, in bytes

vBondAsStunServer.description: Put this wan interface in STUN mode only

vManageConnectionPreference.description: Set interface preference for control connection to vManage <0..8>
